title: Mover Quote Quote Amount Leaderboard
dataSources: Move checklists (`move:checklist`), USPS change-of-address (`usps:change`), mover quotes (`mover:quote`), utility transfers (`utility:transfer`), and box inventories (`box:inventory`).
app: Move checklist task exports, USPS change-of-address confirmations, mover quote comparisons, utility transfer logs, and box inventory scans forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mover:quote quote_usd=*
| stats sum(quote_usd) as total_value, avg(quote_usd) as avg_value by vendor_name
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks mover values by total and average quote amount across mover quote events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `quote_usd` values for each mover quote event and review total and average quote amount by mover.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total quote amount.
grandmaExplanation: It celebrates which mover shows the biggest quote amount numbers in your mover quote data.
